title: Adding a provider/tool/agent/stage/validator implied core edits; no generic plugin/port framework
Issue<->backlog close loop not wired end-to-end (pieces existed, loop never exercised)
Product-scope issue/backlog/RCCA loop was not wired into the pipeline (ingest_defects had zero callers)
No provider-kind abstraction: routing/request-shaping was provider-string based; kind never consulted
No capability-pack registry: modalities detected but never persisted; no catalog to enable media/IoT packs
llm_client built text-only messages; image/audio/video-capable models never received media
No media ingest / asset store: large media cannot be fed (not tokenized by bytes); no per-asset ids/metadata
No generator models/adapters: no catalog model outputs media; image/video/audio generation impossible
No early feasibility/capability triage: projects discover missing generators/shippable weights/host limits only after design/architect
No capability-gated composition: packs persisted but never injected stages/agents; media support would fork the pipeline
Model/capability strategy chosen too early (at creation); no post-ideation or post-architect gate to match modality/architecture
Media never reached agents: to_media/multimodal orphaned, no asset->prompt selection, no media token accounting
Large media could overflow the context and markdown asset refs were not resolved
Media outputs had no quality gate (no probe/loudness/perceptual/av-sync)
No evidence-gated learning: improvements were manual/global and injected everywhere with no approval
Approved learnings were global (applied to every project) and memory was write-only
Approved candidates could not register new knowledge/skills (no operator-gated path, no live-layer check)
No single e2e proof that a media project runs start-to-finish across router+adapter+store+QA
